name: quioteframework/mcp
description: MCP (Model Context Protocol) server capability for Quiote -- expose Quiote actions/tools over MCP.

suggest.firebase/php-jwt: Required when mcp.auth is 'oauth2', for JWKS-backed JWT validation (Mcp\Server\Transport\Http\OAuth\JwtTokenValidator).

extra.quiote-monorepo-note: Developed in-tree under quioteframework/quiote's packages/mcp/; split to this standalone repo via splitsh/lite on tag push. PRs go to the monorepo, not here.
